title: Methodology Record — PhD Thesis Butler v4.0
description: Describes a research methodology route: its approach type, requirements, typical section sequence, and common chapter structure.

methodology_id.description: Unique methodology record ID following convention: methodology_{incremental_id}

name_ru.description: Russian name of the methodology route.

discipline.description: Academic discipline this methodology is associated with.

requires_model.description: True if this methodology typically requires constructing or describing a formal model.

requires_experiment.description: True if this methodology typically requires running experiments or empirical tests.

requires_dataset.description: True if this methodology typically requires a dataset (empirical, survey, archival, etc.).

typical_sections.description: Ordered array of DIS categories typically appearing in dissertations using this methodology. Preserves typical document order.

section_name.description: Name of the chapter or major section (e.g., 'Глава 1', 'Обзор литературы').

purpose_ru.description: Purpose of this section, expressed in Russian.
examples: Обоснование актуальности и формулирование цели исследования
Систематизация существующих подходов и выявление пробелов

common_chapter_structure.description: Common chapter structure for dissertations using this methodology, with section names and their purposes in Russian.

evidence_count.description: Evidence metadata for this methodology record.

count.description: Number of source papers demonstrating this methodology pattern.

source.description: Source identifier. For private builds: paper_id(s). For public output: 'abstracted'.

confidence.description: Confidence: high (≥30 papers), medium (10-29), low (<10), pending (not computed).

source.description: Origin institution or collection. For public output: 'abstracted'.
